correctness.rationale: Three EF rounds on vertex-transitive graphs are decided by realized 2-point profiles and available third-vertex atomic diagrams. For KG(n,k), distinct pair common-neighbor existence is n−2k+|A∩B|≥k, equivalent n≥3k−t. In the connected noncomplete range, adjacent pairs t=0, nonadjacent pairs t∈[1,k−1], separating n≥3k, n=3k−1 and 2k+1≤n≤3k−2; explicit third-vertex choices realize every remaining required adjacency pattern. Edgeless, matching, complete K_n cases add five categories. Eight rank≤3 sentences distinguish the eight signatures. Sparse class H requires k≥3 and smallest graph KG(7,3) with binom(7,3)=35 vertices. Independent exact 3-round extension signatures for eight representatives and additional cases KG(9,3), KG(8,3), KG(9,4), KG(5,3) matched all classes.
